description: text($) of a reads the source of its original tokens alone. A synthetic T that leads the span does not pull in the space before b, so text($) is "b", not " b". a and c both survive (engine §7.5).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T
%rule text A a | A b | A c
%rule a [T] B
%conditions text($) = "b"
%rule b [T] [T] B
%rule c T B
